title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go + parity bumps
author: Rachel Nguyen
commit_summaries: python: normalize auth client construction and default retries
typescript: streaming API ergonomic overloads + typed event helpers
go: fix retry backoff interface and add context-aware wrappers
chore: bump sdks to v0.12.x (python), v1.5.x (ts), v0.7.x (go)
docs: update quickstarts and migration notes
description: Context: Across our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs we had grown divergent ergonomics for auth wiring, retry defaults, and streaming helpers which makes cross-language samples and docs brittle. This PR standardizes the public surface so examples and the Console-driven quickstarts behave consistently. Motivation: reduce support friction, simplify docs, and ensure parity for streaming reconnection semantics and retry/backoff defaults. Changes: normalized auth constructors to accept either an api_key string or an AuthConfig object; introduced unified RetryPolicy with sane defaults (idempotent-aware, exponential backoff with jitter, max_retries=5); streaming APIs now expose typed event objects (data/message/error/close) and a small ergonomic helper (stream.collect_until) in TS and Python and a context-aware streaming iterator in Go. Also bumped SDK package versions and updated changelogs. Commits summary: see commit_summaries field. Files touched: see files_changed field. Testing: added unit tests for auth fallback, retry edge cases, and streaming reconnects in each SDK; integration smoke tests run against the staging gateway. CI: all checks green after two reruns (flake fixes + lint). Review: initial feedback requested clearer naming for RetryPolicy fields and a compatibility shim for legacy auth factory functions; both addressed. Migration notes: added docs/sdk-migration.md with examples showing how to switch to the new constructors and how to opt out of the new retry defaults. Merge: squash and merge to main.
review_comments: Asha: Can we avoid breaking consumers that relied on the old AuthFactory signature? Consider adding a compatibility shim.

release_notes: SDKS: Unified auth constructors across Python/TS/Go to accept API key string or AuthConfig for richer integrations.
SDKS: Introduced unified RetryPolicy with improved defaults and per-client override capability (migration notes included).
SDKS: Streaming APIs now expose typed event objects and ergonomic collectors/iterators across languages for parity.

Docs: migration guide added at docs/sdk-migration.md.
